name: Code Tabs
description: Code component with tabs to show different versions, implementations or comparisons of the same code

structure.html:
LANGUAGE 
// code here
LANGUAGE 
// code here

tabs.description: Array of tabs, each with its code

code.description: Code to be displayed in this tab

active.description: Whether this tab should be active by default

tabs.label: Java 7
Java 8

renderedHtml:
JAVA 7 
List names = Arrays.asList("Java", "Python");
Collections.sort(names, new Comparator() {
    @Override
    public int compare(String s1, String s2) {
        return s1.compareTo(s2);
    }
});
JAVA 8 
List names = Arrays.asList("Java", "Python");
names.sort((s1, s2) -> s1.compareTo(s2));
// Or using method reference
names.sort(String::compareTo);
JAVA 9 
List names = List.of("Java", "Python");
names.stream()
    .sorted()
    .forEach(System.out::println);

javascript.description: JavaScript function required to switch between tabs

css.description: CSS styles must be included in the page or in theme.css
css.location: Can be inline in the page or added to theme.css

features: Multiple tabs for different code versions
Independent syntax highlighting for each tab
Copy code button in each tab
Re-applies syntax highlighting when switching tabs
useCases: Show code evolution between versions (Java 7, 8, 9, 11, etc.)
Show equivalent code in different languages
Demonstrate different approaches to the same problem
Compare code before and after refactoring
notes: The component requires the JavaScript function switchCodeTab() and CSS styles. Make sure to include both in the page. The first tab should have the 'active' class on both the button and the content.
